title: Single ACA revision readiness and continuity
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Update a single ACA revision; the old revision remains until candidate readiness.

sourceContract.readme: S125 | Container Apps, single revision: Verify readiness-gated replacement and user continuity beyond the routing switch itself.
sourceContract.backlog: D-S125 | Add a Container Apps single-revision preset with failed/successful candidate readiness.
sourceContract.acceptance: Old revision routing persists until native readiness permits replacement; active-work/state outcomes are independently verified.
sourceContract.portableCard: A-S125 | Update a single ACA revision; the old revision remains until candidate readiness.
sourceContract.nativeSibling: B-S125 | Conduct one single-revision update; verify actual readiness gating and active-work outcomes.

documentedConstraints.singleRevision: The existing active revision is not deactivated until the candidate is ready; with ingress enabled the old revision receives 100% until then.
readiness: Replica count matches the previous revision while respecting the candidate minimum/maximum.
All replicas passed startup and readiness probes.
documentedConstraints.revisionScope: An image change creates a new revision; it does not mutate the old immutable revision.
documentedConstraints.qualification: Revision/software replacement is not compute-capacity scaling. Nominal update, readiness, observed traffic/lifecycle and user continuity are separate evidence.

preconditions: Every app, revision, image, replica, readiness, traffic, lifecycle, session and effect value is fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY.
Single-revision and ingress-enabled are fictional assumptions, not resource configuration.
Old lesson-api--r1 initially serves 100%; only fixed v2 / fictional-image-v2 is selectable.
Fictional per-revision target/minimum/maximum all remain 2; temporary overlap is not a sustained capacity change.
Two user journeys preserve identity, session and cart:3 within the original 400 ms budget.
Old work-17 must independently complete with preserved state and effect-17 committed exactly once.
actions: Choose a fixed observation fixture and record candidate update DATA using exact token v2.
Inspect provisioning, replica count and all startup/readiness probe DATA.
Inspect intended versus observed traffic and lifecycle DATA separately.
Inspect session/state journeys and old-work/effect DATA independently.
Inspect measured positive, negative and unknown outcomes and retained history.
Reset only this page's in-memory rehearsal.
assertions: Old revision stays active at 100% through nominal update and failed/unknown readiness.
Positive readiness permits replacement but does not itself observe the traffic switch.
Unknown current traffic/lifecycle is not presented as the last known old 100% route.
Sessions/state and old work/effects are separate measured results; attempted unknown/failed journeys remain counted.
Strict exact command fields, types, token/fixture allowlists and deterministic state/history replay reject forgery and coercion.
Twelve actions are retained without pruning; typed errors do not mutate state/history.
Keyboard submission, visible focus, semantic safe holds, alert/status and prototype-based form reset work.
Missing model DATA fails visibly; actual CSP denies inline script/event/style, eval, connections, frames, images and form navigation.

verification.normalVerification: READ-ONLY: no source/evidence rewrite, including preexisting raw browser captures.
verification.deliberateCapture: Only exact CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 writes a new unique raw browser observation file; no prior file is overwritten.
verification.helper: testing\browser\isolated.cjs at 53c0c0d; openIsolatedLesson and awaited finally close.
verification.tooling: Existing Node 22.23.4 / offline Playwright 1.56.1 / Microsoft-signed Edge 156.0.4314.50; test tooling only.
verification.archivedRed: evidence\red-stub\assertions.cjs with exact loadable no-op stub bytes, outside normal test autodiscovery.
verification.sourceByteIntegrity: evidence\source-hashes.json distinguishes raw byte SHA-256 from canonical LF and Git blob identities.
verification.iac: N/A: fixed-data, resource-free browser lesson; no IaC generated.

limits: No actual ACA, registry, revision, image, probe, route, resource, configuration, session, effect, lifecycle, promotion or deployment operation.
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity, credentials, packages, framework, downloads, unsafe flags or expenditure.
No native Azure proof, production Node.js 24 validation, source-parent completion, unattended browser-harness qualification or five-nines claim.
The published isolated helper has known unattended context/page/cleanup lifecycle limitations; its inactive recovery prototype remains unqualified.
B-S125 requires an approved native target and independent measured readiness, actual routing, state and active-work evidence.
One original frozen S unit only after parent-owned acceptance; tests, repairs, proofs and refinements earn zero extra credits.
C005-C008 and local-harness catalog integration remain parent-owned and untouched.
